name: Web
description: Standard HTTP web applications and web servers security
attack_surface: Public web ports (80, 443, 8080), HTTP headers, TLS configurations, and client-side resources
common_misconfigurations: Debug or development mode left active in production
Missing security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type)
Directory listing enabled on upload or static asset servers
validation_methods: Directory and file fuzzed endpoints checks
Source code or JavaScript asset map review
evidence_requirements: Full HTTP Request and Response headers sequence
Visual screenshot of debug outputs or listed directory files
false_positive_indicators: WAF returning fake block page response codes
Simulated dev server routes mimicking debug panels
reporting_guidance: Flag CSP/CORS/HSTS issues only when paired with a working proof-of-concept showing cross-origin read or clickjacking exploitation.
